name: ch_law_search
description: Search Swiss federal legislation (Fedlex, Federal Chancellery) by title word, abbreviation or SR number, in German, French, Italian or English: e.g. query "Datenschutz" lang "de", query "protection des donnees" lang "fr", abbreviation "DSG", or sr_number "235.1" (the Classified Compilation number). By default only acts in force today are returned (in_force_only=false adds repealed and not-yet-in-force acts). Returns id (the SR number, usable in ch_law_get), title, short title, SR number, AS (Official Compilation) reference, entry-into-force date, status and link; 25 per page, use page to continue. Federal law only, no cantonal law and no EU law.

query.description: Word(s) from the title in the chosen language, all must match, e.g. "Datenschutz" or "protection des donnees"

sr_number.description: Classified Compilation (SR) number, e.g. "235.1" (use instead of query)

lang.description: Language of the title search and of the titles returned (default de)

in_force_only.description: Only acts in force today (default true)

name: ch_law_get
description: Fetch one Swiss federal act: its record and consolidated text. id is an SR number from ch_law_search (e.g. "235.1" for the Federal Act on Data Protection) or an Official Compilation reference like "2022/491". Returns title, short title, SR number, AS reference, adoption and entry-into-force dates, in-force status, the date of the consolidated version returned (the version applicable today) and the text. Pass article (e.g. "6", "66a") for one article only; without it the text is capped at max_chars with a list of chapters. lang picks the language (de, fr, it, en when available). The consolidated text is informative as published; the legal force lies with the Official Compilation.

max_chars.description: Cap on returned text when no article is given (default 20000, max 100000)
